steps.text: a lesson step: the instrument, and the one thing to do
press rec: four clicks count you in
tap the open hat on every "and", between the kicks
four out of four: your hats go into your song
your hats are kept. now you shape them
turn decay: each hat gets shorter or longer
the screen draws what the knob is doing to the sound
today's five minutes, picked from your lessons
each drill trains one thing your ears need
open copy by ear
listen to the target part
tap the steps where you heard it
check: every note is marked right or off
the studio: your song on real instruments
play the pads
turn a knob and hear the sound change
press play to hear your song
arrange: your loop becomes sections
switch a part on or off in each section
send to Live: the song opens in Ableton Live
two decks and a mixer, like a real controller
play deck a: your song
start deck b: another track
slide the crossfader from a to b
turn down the bass on deck a
match deck b's tempo
or press sync to match it for you
and mix back the other way
every device in Live, in one place
search by name, or by what you want to hear
more space: the devices that do that
each device opens on a loop
press play
turn a knob: the screen says what it does
a and b: hear it without, then with
